headline: Reddit shifts karma system to AI moderation; Google loses key search architect Jeff Dean shifts role

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Reddit aims to make 'karma' less important for first-time posters with shift to AI moderation | Reddit正降低新用户发帖的karma权重，转向AI审核
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: UGC平台的内容审核机制变化直接影响品牌声誉管理和社区营销策略，AI审核可能改变内容可见性规则
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: Glenn Gabe data research on Reddit platform changes
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Glenn Gabe flagged Reddit's announced shift from karma-based to AI-driven moderation for first-time posters. The change aims to reduce barrier to entry but may alter content distribution patterns. No quantitative impact data available yet; this is platform-reported intent, not measured outcome.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: monitor Reddit brand mention patterns | audit community management workflows

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Bing product feeds guide for ecommerce AI SEO published | Bing商品Feed优化指南发布
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: Bing Shopping在AI搜索中的权重上升，product feed优化是ecommerce GEO的关键基础设施
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence: Brodie Clark expert analysis with full methodology guide
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: Brodie Clark published a comprehensive guide on brodieclark.com covering Bing product feed setup, optimization, and integration with AI search features. The guide includes specific feed specifications and ecommerce-focused tactics. No controlled experiment data; this is practitioner-tested methodology based on platform documentation and client work.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: audit Bing Merchant Center feed completeness | test product title optimization
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: Set up Bing product feed with AI-optimized titles (feature-benefit structure, 150 chars), submit to Bing Merchant Center, compare CTR and impression share vs. standard titles over 4-6 weeks
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: Bing Shopping CTR, impression share, and conversion rate from product listing ads
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: Medium: feed setup 2-4 hours; risk of title changes affecting existing performance

Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_happened: Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean steps away from core search/AI leadership role | Google搜索与AI核心架构师Jeff Dean转岗
Unconfirmed Watchlist.why_it_matters: 搜索架构长期稳定性存疑，需关注Google Search技术路线是否转向Gemini-first，传统ranking系统可能加速重构
Unconfirmed Watchlist.evidence: Search Engine Journal reporting on internal Google reorganization
Unconfirmed Watchlist.evidence_detail: Jeff Dean, who led Google Brain and was instrumental in modern search infrastructure, is reportedly shifting to a less central role. This follows DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis taking broader control of Google AI. SEJ cites internal sources; Google has not issued formal statement on search leadership changes.
Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_to_do: monitor Google Search quality updates frequency | no immediate action
